decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD sits close to the firm's established compilation expertise, so it can stay as low-cost catalog stock, though its fit with the firm's non-mainstream audience is weaker.
The illustrated release series builds directly on the firm's curation and careful-edition know-how, and as a multi-model line it gives the firm ongoing learning about collector demand.
Reissuing overlooked jazz on vinyl is the core competence of this label, so it can interpret the results well and keep the title in its catalog at little cost.
The multi-disc box set uses the firm's existing reissue and production knowledge, but limited-edition box sets often sell out and are not repressed, which raises the chance it leaves the market.
This compilation CD fits established competencies but was only mentioned rather than presented on its own page, which suggests lower priority, yet keeping it in a warehouse catalog costs little.
